Stimulate your cat's play instinct with our Matatabi play spray - natural fun for your pet Matatabi Play Spray is the ideal solution to stimulate your cat's play instinct and provide hours of fun. The play spray contains a natural extract of Matatabi, a plant known for its stimulating effect on cats. By spraying the play spray onto objects for play or cuddling, you can arouse your pet's interest and attention. Matatabi extract contains essential oils that can increase your cat's play instinct and curiosity. Matatabi is thus a natural alternative to conventional catnip can stimulate your cat's senses and have a positive effect on her well-being. Matatabi play spray is easy to use.
